adjudication.rationale: In `lib/topic_retriever.rb` `perform_retrieve` unconditionally runs `Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({})` whenever `SiteSetting.feed_polling_enabled?` is true and the current `@embed_url` is not yet in `topic_embeds` (it checks existence before and after). `Jobs::PollFeed#poll_feed` (`app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`) fetches `SiteSetting.feed_polling_url` and iterates/imports every item, so this is a synchronous full-feed poll triggered by a per-URL embed cache miss. The per-URL throttle (`retrieved_recently?`) keys on `retrieved:#{@embed_url}` and can be bypassed via `no_throttle` (set for staff in `Jobs::RetrieveTopic`), so staff requests could cause repeated full feed downloads. This is a concrete load/architecture concern introduced by the diff, not a correctness defect per se.
